<TITLE>EX-3.1</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 3.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PLATINUM SPINCO INC. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>OF THE </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF
INCORPORATION </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Platinum SpinCo Inc. (the &#8220;<B>Corporation</B>&#8221;), a corporation organized and existing under and by virtue
of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware (the &#8220;<B>DGCL</B>&#8221;) </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>DOES HEREBY CERTIFY: </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>FIRST</B>: That the original certificate of incorporation of the Corporation was filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware
on January&nbsp;23, 2026. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SECOND</B>: That the board of directors of the Corporation (the &#8220;<B>Board</B>&#8221;) acting by the
unanimous written consent of its members in accordance with Section&nbsp;141(f) of the DGCL, filed with the minutes of the Board, duly adopted resolutions setting forth the following proposed amendment to the certificate of incorporation of the
Corporation (the &#8220;<B>Certificate of Incorporation</B>&#8221;) and declaring its advisability, pursuant to which Article IV of the Certificate of Incorporation is amended and restated so that, as amended, said Article shall read in its entirety
as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE IV </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CAPITAL STOCK </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;4.1 <U>Authorized Capital Stock</U>. The Corporation shall be authorized to issue one class of stock to be designated Common
Stock (the &#8220;<U>Common Stock</U>&#8221;); the total number of shares of Common Stock which the Corporation shall have authority to issue is 60,000,000, and each such share shall have a par value of $0.001. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;4.2 <U>Recapitalization</U>. Effective as of the time at which this Certificate of Amendment becomes effective in accordance with
the DGCL (such time, the &#8220;<U>Recapitalization Time</U>&#8221;), all shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Recapitalization Time (including, for the avoidance of doubt, any shares of Common Stock issued by the
Corporation to Modine Manufacturing Company, a Wisconsin corporation (&#8220;<U>Modine</U>&#8221;), at any time prior to the Recapitalization Time) shall, automatically without any further action on the part of the Corporation or any holder of
shares of capital stock of the Corporation, be reclassified and converted into, in the aggregate, a number of validly issued, fully paid and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-assessable</FONT> shares of Common Stock authorized for issuance
pursuant to this Certificate of Incorporation equal to (a)&nbsp;the total number of shares of common stock, par value $0.625 per share, of Modine (the &#8220;<U>Modine Common Stock</U>&#8221;) issued and outstanding as of the close of business,
Eastern Time, on the Record Date (as defined in the Separation Agreement, dated January&nbsp;29, 2026, among the Corporation, Modine and Gentherm Incorporated), excluding any shares of Modine Common Stock held as treasury stock by Modine or held by
any of Modine&#8217;s subsidiaries, in each case, as of such time, minus (b)&nbsp;the excess, if any, of (i) 2,000, which represents the number of shares of Common Stock issuable to Modine in accordance with the Equity Contribution Agreement, dated
as of September&nbsp;28, 2026, by and between the Corporation and Modine (the &#8220;<U>Equity Contribution Agreement</U>&#8221;), over (ii)&nbsp;the number of such shares of Common Stock, if any, that were issued to Modine in accordance with the
Equity Contribution Agreement prior to the Recapitalization Time (the aggregate number of shares of Common Stock resulting from the foregoing calculation, the &#8220;<U>Modine Share Count</U>,&#8221; and such reclassification and conversion, the
&#8220;<U>Recapitalization</U>&#8221;). For the avoidance of doubt, the shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Recapitalization Time shall be included in, and shall not be in addition to, the aggregate number of
shares of Common Stock into which such shares are reclassified and converted pursuant to the Recapitalization, such that the total number of shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately following the Recapitalization Time shall be equal
to (and shall not exceed) the Modine Share Count. Each stock certificate or book-entry position that, immediately prior to the Recapitalization Time, represented shares of Common Stock shall, from and after the Recapitalization Time and without any
surrender or exchange thereof, represent the number of shares of Common Stock into which such shares have been reclassified and converted pursuant to the Recapitalization. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>THIRD</B>: That in lieu of a meeting and vote of stockholders, the sole stockholder of
the Corporation has signed and delivered its written consent to said amendment in accordance with the provisions of Section&nbsp;228 of the DGCL. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>FOURTH</B>: That the aforesaid amendment was duly adopted in accordance with the applicable provisions of Sections 228 and 242 of the DGCL.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>FIFTH</B>: That this Certificate of Amendment shall be effective upon its filing with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[<I>Signature page follows</I>] </P>
</DIV></Center>

undersigned on September 29, 2026. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV ALIGN="right">
